task.title: Replace profile switcher browser prompt with custom modal
task.description:
Replace the window.prompt() call in switchProfile() with a custom modal. (1) Add modal HTML before closing body tag:

Create a New Profile

Use profiles for different outreach contexts — e.g. Vendors vs Customers — each with its own contacts and settings.

Enter a unique profile name.
(2) In switchProfile(name): when name is empty string (new profile), instead of calling prompt(), show the modal: document.getElementById('newProfileModal').classList.remove('hidden');document.getElementById('newProfileName').value='';document.getElementById('newProfileName').focus(); (3) Wire newProfileCreate button: read newProfileName value, validate not empty and not in existing profiles, call setProfile(val), add to profiles list, save, close modal, call renderProfileSelector(), showView('dashboard'), updateQueueBadge(), toast. (4) Wire close/cancel buttons. (5) Add updateQueueBadge() call at the end of switchProfile() after showView('dashboard').
task.project_vision: Frontend-only AI outreach SaaS. Single HTML file. localStorage. Surgical edits only.

None of the required custom profile creation modal infrastructure is present. The spec requires: modal HTML (#newProfileModal with #newProfileName input, #newProfileErr error display, #newProfileClose, #newProfileCancel buttons), modal-specific CSS classes for overlay/box/header/body/actions, four new functions (showNewProfileModal, hideNewProfileModal, handleCreateProfile, initProfileModal), event handler attachments, and integration with the existing profile system to replace window.prompt(). All these features are completely missing from the visible code.

blocking_issues: AI Guide modal has no mobile responsive styles - fixed positioning at 340px width will overflow on small screens and bottom:90px may cause button overlap
Guide modal max-height:480px may exceed viewport on mobile devices with no scrolling fallback
Guide button (52px) positioned at bottom:28px right:28px will overlap with mobile browser chrome/UI on many devices
No skip-to-content link for keyboard navigation accessibility
Form inputs missing explicit <label> association (no 'for'/'id' attributes) - breaks screen readers
No focus management when modals open/close - keyboard users trapped
Modals lack proper ARIA roles (role='dialog', aria-labelledby, aria-modal='true')
Color contrast likely fails WCAG AA on sidebar nav items (.6 opacity text on dark background)
Touch targets under 44x44px minimum (nav-badge, modal-close, btn-xs) - fails mobile accessibility
No viewport height handling on mobile - 100vh causes issues with mobile browser chrome
Active states rely solely on color - no shape/icon change for colorblind users
